fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full birth name as it appears on the birth certificate. Used for every letter-based number in the chart: Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Karmic Lessons, Hidden Passion, Subconscious Self and the special letters. A name in any script is converted to Latin letters before it is counted, Cyrillic and Greek as the passport spelling and accents folded to the base letter, and the calculation lists the letters counted. For a script that does not write its vowels, send the Latin spelling the person uses.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Birth year between 100 and 2100. Supports historical figures like Einstein (1879) and Shakespeare (1564).

fields.name: currentYear
fields.description: Calendar year for the Personal Year, defaults to the current UTC year. It moves the Personal Year only: the nested personalMonth and maturityStatus.currentAge always read the current UTC date.
